Afternic, a GoDaddy brand, is the world's premier domain marketplace, and the place to turn your domain investment dreams into reality. Founded in 1999, Afternic was a pioneer of the domain aftermarket, and is still the leader with over 23 million listings and largest network of registrar partners serving up domains to buyers. But Afternic is more than just a place to list your domain. It’s a full-service domain partner that’s here to help you from listing your domain to closing the sale — and beyond. We bring the buyers. For over 23 years, we’ve continuously invested to create a unified domain aftermarket that stretches to all the places where buyers search for that perfect domain. Today, there are 100+ distribution partners, including 8 of the top 10 registrars, listing your domains and others to over 125 million monthly domain purchase search queries.^ For that, we are the place to list once and sell everywhere. Our people close sales. Afternic and GoDaddy have hundreds of experts dedicated to the domain aftermarket, helping sellers succeed. This team of experts stands ready to work with you to set a competitive price, market your domain to millions of potential buyers, and handle all of the negotiations and paperwork — so you can focus on what you do best. Whether you’re selling your domains or holding them as investments, you can earn money through Afternic’s parking platform. We place highly relevant ads onto your domain’s landing page, and you earn the revenue. Get Started Park and list for sale. Have the best of both worlds by monetizing your domains while also listing them for sale. Parked domains that you list for sale will display a “Domain For Sale” link that brings prospective buyers into Afternic’s domain sales platform, where they will engage with our expert brokerage team. Earn recurring revenue while waiting for the right buyer to come along. How to set up domain parking. We’ll set up your pages with highly optimized ads relevant to your domain’s visitors. Just kick back and watch the money come in. Get Started Create an Afternic account or log in to your existing one. If you haven’t already, setup your parking profile located within the Suggestions tab of the Dashboard. To make sure you get paid, head to your Account Settings and complete the Domain Parking Payments section. Go to your Portfolio page and add any new domains you’d like park. Set the lander preference as CashParking for each domain. Go to your domain’s registrar and update the nameservers to point to: Primary: NS1.AFTERNIC.COM Secondary: NS2.AFTERNIC.COM A “Domain for Sale” link will be automatically added to your parking page. This will increase the likelihood of a successful sale.
